scope.goal: Create the authoritative evidence inventory and reconstruction acceptance contract.
scope.target: Current product architecture, behavior, contracts, runtime topology, tests, and existing specification coverage.
constraints: Prefer codebase-memory graph tools for code discovery.
Separate observed behavior, intended behavior, inference, and open decisions.
Do not modify product source or tests.

user_constraints: A LUNA-class AI must be able to reconstruct an equal-or-better system after product source removal.

steps: Inventory current evidence and existing documentation.
Define coverage dimensions and evidence-status vocabulary.
Create the reconstruction manifest and gap register.
Hand off confirmed inputs to requirement and architecture authoring.
validation: Every active product project and host appears in the inventory.
Every evidenced use case and integration channel appears in the coverage matrix.
Existing spec and test coverage gaps are explicit.
execution.commit_checkpoint: Commit with the first coherent validated specification batch.

results.summary: Inventoried 22 product projects, four test projects, six hosts, 16 use cases, 15 HTTP endpoints, persistence models, messaging profiles, current evidence, and reconstruction gaps.
approval_evidence: GitHub Issue #2 is OPEN and read back.
validation_evidence: Codebase Memory index refreshed at source revision 59d651e46816ddf82174bbc97f2cf1f21b71fe92.
Project manifest includes generator, revision, scope, exclusions, and reproduction instructions.
